title: PolyDiff Opengraph-Family Fact Vector
description: Per-implementation fact vector for the opengraph family. Sibling of fact-vector.schema.json (URL family) and fact-vector-image.schema.json (image family); all share input_id + parser_profile as the cross-family identity keys that the diff engine pairs vectors on. Axes follow the T-M2.2 spec: og_title, og_image, og_type, og_url, og_video, twitter_card_type, twitter_image, oembed_type, canonical_url, parser_warnings, decode_outcome. When a wrapper binary/package is absent the wrapper emits a crash envelope with binary_missing=true and decode_outcome.status=crash; that envelope still validates so the missing parser stays auditable in the diff report.

binary_missing.description: Set by the wrapper when the underlying Python parser package/binary is not available. The opengraph axes are then null and decode_outcome.status MUST be 'crash'.

og_title.description: Value of <meta property='og:title'> as parsed. null when absent or not observable.

og_image.description: Value of <meta property='og:image'> as parsed. URL string. null when absent.

og_type.description: Value of <meta property='og:type'> as parsed. Examples: article, website, video.movie. null when absent.

og_url.description: Value of <meta property='og:url'> as parsed (resolved if relative). This axis is where the Facebook-crawler-vs-WHATWG-URL divergence surfaces. null when absent.

og_video.description: Value of <meta property='og:video'> as parsed. URL string. null when absent.

twitter_card_type.description: Value of <meta name='twitter:card'>. Examples: summary, summary_large_image, player, app. The player card type historically had XSS-prone url-sanitization variance. null when absent.

twitter_image.description: Value of <meta name='twitter:image'>. URL string. null when absent.

oembed_type.description: Value of the `type` field in an oEmbed JSON/XML response (photo, video, link, rich). null when not an oEmbed response.

canonical_url.description: Value of <link rel='canonical' href='...'> as parsed. null when absent.

parser_warnings.description: Implementation-emitted warnings (e.g. 'unrecognized og:type', 'malformed meta tag'). Empty array on a clean parse.

decode_outcome.description: Implementation-reported parse outcome. status='crash' indicates wrapper subprocess crashed (segfault, FileNotFoundError); 'oom' indicates allocation refused; 'decode_error' is a clean rejection by the parser; 'ok' is a clean parse.
